Classical formula/mean are explicitly attributed. Exact-rational standalone enumeration checks 810,521 cases with n up to 4 but does not replace the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: The motivating Ortega–Ziegler–Arribillaga–Zhao paper establishes a first moment under independent uniform preferences and explicitly leaves correlated preferences open. Myers–Wilf gives the classical coupon-singleton distribution, not a correlated RSD coupling. A previously known independent-rank full law requires iid entire rankings and does not entail the distributional dimension reduction when two or more students have a forced common favorite. The primary overlapping correlated-matching paper concerns two-sided stable matchings under Mallows preferences. Targeted comparisons identified no statement with equivalent hypotheses and full law, although an unindexed earlier coupling is a genuine residual priority risk.
residual_risks: An earlier unindexed coupling of common-first-choice RSD to the reduced coupon collector may exist.
The result does not extend to other correlated ranking distributions without new arguments.
External independent peer verification and bibliographic priority assessment have not occurred.

value.rationale: An exact entire probability distribution in a naturally correlated common-demand school-choice model addresses the explicit non-iid gap in the motivating 2026 paper. The threshold at two shared-top students and complete invariance for larger designated groups yield a structural classification valid at every market size and permit direct reuse of known coupon law for all tails and means; not an arbitrary small numerical slice.
